- Adapted to official Telegram Desktop 7.4.1
- Added interactive HTML widgets in bot messages, so you can now use controls directly inside the chat
- Improved settings layouts, which now keep long labels, download folder options and slider tick labels readable
- Improved wallet transaction details, which now display addresses and small fiat amounts more clearly
- Fixed an issue with Windows startup, post search and archived stories that previously caused crashes

---

- 适配了官方 Telegram Desktop 7.4.1
- 新增了机器人消息中的交互式 HTML 控件，现在可以直接在聊天中操作控件
- 对设置布局进行了改善，这使得长标题、下载目录选项和滑块刻度更清晰易读
- 对钱包交易详情进行了改善，这使得地址和小额法币金额的显示更清晰
- 修复了关于 Windows 启动、帖子搜索和动态归档的错误，该问题曾导致程序崩溃
